status: PROPOSED: these new integration endpoints must be implemented and tested.
existing_application: TFSC Compliance v4.0.0; preserve existing cookie/CSRF endpoints

trust.browser_auth: Separate OIDC clients and server sessions; immutable issuer+subject mapping
trust.service_auth: Narrow server-to-server credentials, authenticated transport, verifiable initiating subject, replay protection; do not trust browser role strings
trust.scope: Both apps independently recheck current organization, application, resource and company grants

new_endpoints.purpose: Create or retrieve an idempotent editable draft mapping
Authorized progress for the integration caller
Authenticated intended browser user redeems a single-use reference
Freeze a candidate revision for review
Approve exact version and hash under scoped reviewer policy
Record review reason and changes requested
Atomically check approval and enqueue immutable revision
Authenticated, idempotent receipt of agreement milestones

request_requirements.idempotency_key: Required UUID or documented bounded equivalent. Persist body hash and result. Same key with different body returns 409.
request_requirements.correlation_id: Required across both applications, outbox and job
request_requirements.expected_version: Required for updates/transitions; stale version returns 409
request_requirements.tenant_resolution: Resolve from trusted authenticated service plus actor mapping, not unchecked user input
request_requirements.unknown_fields: Reject in integration DTO; do not silently drop stable link fields

client.address: Synthetic test address; replace with validated client address

services.details: Illustrative value only; validate against the existing catalog and actual agreed pricing.

handoff_request_example.note: This example is semantic. The implementation must translate model IDs and fields using the actual TFSC validators, not assume this illustrative model literal is accepted.

handoff_response_requirements: opaque single-use browser reference when ready

event_envelope_example.note: All values are synthetic placeholders, not an issued agreement.

event_rules: Transactional outbox in producer; durable inbox unique event_id in receiver.
No event may elevate permissions or mark an unverified execution.
Record source aggregate version and tolerate out-of-order delivery without regressing state.
Acknowledge only durable receipt; retry with backoff and dead-letter review.
Event payload contains IDs and necessary status only, not raw document bytes or private CRM meeting/project details.
Check file access at TFSC for every retrieval; do not send reusable public download URLs.

artifact_consistency.browser_folder_copy: Optional user-selected local mirror; acknowledge separately

errors.403: Insufficient app/company/scope permission without secret disclosure
errors.404: Missing or inaccessible object under nonenumeration policy
errors.429: Rate or queue limit; documented retry
errors.503: Temporary dependency failure; retriable with same idempotency key

compatibility_tests: Current client IDs and document hashes remain stable after migration.
Legacy finalized records have explicit historical status, not fabricated approvals.
Repeated handoff does not duplicate client, contract or sign-up celebration.
